segments.ja452:1.1: Saccaṃ kira tvaṃ api [tvampi (sī.), tuvampi (syā.), tvaṃ asi (ka.)] bhūripañña, yā tādisī sīri dhitī matī ca;
segments.ja452:1.3: Na tāyatebhāvavasūpanitaṃ, yo yavakaṃ bhuñjasi appasūpaṃ.
segments.ja452:2.1: Sukhaṃ dukkhena paripācayanto, kālā kālaṃ vicinaṃ chandachanno;
segments.ja452:2.3: Atthassa dvārāni avāpuranto, tenāhaṃ tussāmi yavodanena.
segments.ja452:3.1: Kālañca ñatvā abhijīhanāya, mantehi atthaṃ paripācayitvā;
segments.ja452:3.3: Vijambhissaṃ sīhavijambhitāni, tāyiddhiyā dakkhasi maṃ punāpi.
segments.ja452:4.1: Sukhīpi heke [sukhī hi eke (sī.), sukhīti heke (?)] na karonti pāpaṃ, avaṇṇasaṃsaggabhayā puneke;
segments.ja452:4.3: Pahū samāno vipulatthacintī, kiṃkāraṇā me na karosi dukkhaṃ.
segments.ja452:5.1: Na paṇḍitā attasukhassa hetu, pāpāni kammāni samācaranti;
segments.ja452:5.3: Dukkhena phuṭṭhā khalitāpi santā, chandā ca dosā na jahanti dhammaṃ.
segments.ja452:6.1: Yena kenaci vaṇṇena, mudunā dāruṇena vā;
segments.ja452:7.1: Yassa rukkhassa chāyāya, nisīdeyya sayeyya vā;
segments.ja452:7.3: Na tassa sākhaṃ bhañjeyya, mittadubbho hi pāpako.
segments.ja452:8.1: Yassāpi [yassa hi (sī. ka.)] dhammaṃ puriso [manujo (sī.)] vijaññā, ye cassa kaṅkhaṃ vinayanti santo;
segments.ja452:8.3: Taṃ hissa dīpañca parāyanañca, na tena mettiṃ jarayetha pañño.
segments.ja452:9.1: Alaso gihī kāmabhogī na sādhu, asaññato pabbajito na sādhu;
segments.ja452:9.3: Rājā na sādhu anisammakārī, yo paṇḍito kodhano taṃ na sādhu.
segments.ja452:10.3: Nisammakārino rāja, yaso kitti ca vaḍḍhatīti.
